title: Products Overview
content: Divi's Labs manufactures a wide range of pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products. Our core business is organized into three segments: Generic Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Custom Synthesis (Contract Research and Manufacturing Services for innovator companies), and Nutraceutical ingredients used in dietary supplements and functional foods.

title: Generic APIs
content: Divi's Labs is one of the largest manufacturers of Generic Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs) globally. We supply APIs across therapeutic categories to regulated markets, supported by backward-integrated manufacturing facilities that ensure consistent quality and supply reliability.

title: Custom Synthesis (CRAMS)
content: Our Custom Synthesis division partners with global innovator pharmaceutical companies to manufacture patented, complex molecules under long-term contracts. This includes end-to-end process development, scale-up, and commercial manufacturing under strict confidentiality and quality agreements.

title: Nutraceutical Ingredients
content: Divi's Labs manufactures nutraceutical ingredients including Omega-3 fatty acids and other functional ingredients used by supplement and food manufacturers worldwide. Our nutraceutical facilities follow the same quality standards applied across our pharmaceutical operations.

title: Quality and Regulatory Compliance
content: All Divi's Labs manufacturing facilities are approved by leading regulatory authorities including the US FDA, and comply with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP). Our facilities also hold certifications from European and other international regulatory bodies.

title: Manufacturing Facilities
content: Divi's Labs operates multiple manufacturing units located in India, including facilities in Telangana and Andhra Pradesh. These facilities are equipped with backward-integrated production capabilities, from basic raw materials through to finished active ingredients.

title: Contact and Customer Support
content: Customers and business partners can reach Divi's Labs through the contact form on our website, or through our regional sales offices. For product-specific inquiries, customers are encouraged to specify the product name and intended regulatory market.
